does: Takes the target's eoc::HealthComponent and writes the new hit points from the change it is given, clamped at 0; called by the damage event of the stats system

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on a goblin's eoc::HealthComponent.Hp (+0x0) during a fair melee hit for 7 on 2 hit points: the write of 0 came from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x31C2DAE in the ECS frame of the damage, return address inside esv::StatsSystem::ThrowDamageEvent (bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x31C34A5); Health.Hp read 0 after
A write watch on a creature's hit points over a hit is hit at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x31C2DAE inside this function
